title: Complete quality gate performance architecture
outOfScope: Removing or weakening coverage, security, SBOM, provenance, installer, compatibility, or release evidence gates
Changing Branch Protection or claiming hosted performance improvement without measured evidence
Publishing a release or changing release identity metadata; this Work Item may only refresh the source-bound SBOM digest field required by evidence consistency
Treating unavailable hosted before/after measurements as proof of improvement
Deleting WI-20 historical evidence or rewriting its archived Summary

sources.reason: WI-20 archived Summary records the three performance omissions that this corrective Work Item must close.
Current quality-fast/full/release ownership and gate entrypoints.
Hosted template-smoke quality, installation, and evidence sequence.
User-ordered corrective Work Item sequence and WI-20 known gaps.

riskAssessment.reason: Workflow and quality-gate changes can create duplicate execution or silently omit evidence; all changes must remain fail-closed and measured.

executionDecision.reason: User authorized serial execution; WI-21 must close WI-20 omissions without weakening any evidence gate.

preReviewWarnings: Review independent Job ownership, per-gate timing, and whether hosted before/after evidence is measured or explicitly not-run.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: Workflow quality, installation-smoke, and release-evidence responsibilities are represented by explicit independent Job ownership with no duplicate full-quality invocation.
Every quality gate has machine-readable timing, log, exit status, and digest evidence; summaries identify the single owner and preserve failure tails.
Five hosted before/after scenario classes are measured against WI-20 baseline where available; unavailable measurements are recorded with structured not-run reasons and no improvement claim.
Local quality-fast/full/release equivalence, coverage, security, supply-chain, installer, compatibility, and workflow ownership regression tests pass.
English, Chinese, and Japanese quality-gate documentation and instruction-to-plan traceability are aligned with the implementation and known limitations.
The complete Contract→preflight/checkpoint→implementation→verification→Summary→PR/CI→merge→archive→ai-close→branch cleanup→main synchronization lifecycle succeeds.
guidelines: Do not trade evidence completeness or coverage for speed.
Unknown scope and unavailable hosted measurements fail closed or remain explicitly not-run.
Every optimization must preserve a reproducible, machine-readable evidence trail.

intent.problem: WI-20 delivered de-duplication and fast/full/release entrypoints but its archived Summary leaves three release-relevant performance gaps: workflow Job ownership is not fully separated, timing is not per gate, and five hosted before/after scenario measurements are absent.
constraints: Use the latest synchronized origin/main after the preparation Work Item is closed.
Do not remove, weaken, skip, or reclassify required quality, security, supply-chain, installer, compatibility, or release evidence.
Do not claim hosted performance improvement without source-bound before/after evidence.
Keep all changes within this Work Item and update the plan, Summary, status, tests, and three-language documentation.
intent.rationale: Closing the explicit WI-20 omissions is required to make the observed quality-gate optimization auditable and to prevent future long-running release attempts from hiding duplicate or unmeasured work.

rawUserRequest: 按已确认顺序先完成性能优化，再处理 WI-20 遗漏；所有工单必须按“指示—计划—实现—验收”双向追踪，完整走 PR、合并、归档、关闭、分支清理和 main 同步。发布必须延后到这些事项及所有流程问题解决以后。

declaredIntent.summary: Complete WI-20 performance omissions with measurable, fail-closed evidence before any release Work Item.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A workflow change would run full quality more than once.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Ownership check fails or identifies one authoritative full-quality owner before merge.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A gate fails or times out during hosted execution.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The gate records status, timing, log tail, and digest without masking the failure.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A hosted before/after measurement cannot be obtained.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The report records a structured not-run reason and does not claim performance improvement.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: An optimization removes or weakens a required evidence gate.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Regression tests and quality gates fail closed.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User explicitly authorized serial performance optimization, workflow correction, PR lifecycle, and process issue recording; no release publication is authorized by this Work Item.
